featuresShipped.subtitle: Merged PRs and solved issues behind the count

note.title: Output Metric
note.body_one: Features Shipped counts merged PRs and solved issues without a PR over the last {{count}} day. A plan with three PRs counts three features; an issue-only plan counts one.
note.body_other: Features Shipped counts merged PRs and solved issues without a PR over the last {{count}} days. A plan with three PRs counts three features; an issue-only plan counts one.

costPerFeature.subtitle: The two figures the quotient is taken from

note.title: Unit Cost
note.body: Avg Cost per Feature divides {{days}}-day spend by {{days}}-day features shipped, so the card shows the exact quotient of the two cards beside it.

note.title: Usage & Subsidized Analysis
note.bodySubsidized_one: Forecast This Month projects month-end spend using daily activity over the last {{count}} day. {{percent}} of tokens in this window were subsidized via subscription ({{subsidizedValue}} equivalent value) with {{apiCharges}} in direct API charges.
note.bodySubsidized_other: Forecast This Month projects month-end spend using daily activity over the last {{count}} days. {{percent}} of tokens in this window were subsidized via subscription ({{subsidizedValue}} equivalent value) with {{apiCharges}} in direct API charges.
note.body_one: Forecast This Month projects month-end spend using daily activity over the last {{count}} day. Direct API projections estimate billed out-of-pocket spend, while total projections reflect overall token market value.
note.body_other: Forecast This Month projects month-end spend using daily activity over the last {{count}} days. Direct API projections estimate billed out-of-pocket spend, while total projections reflect overall token market value.

daily.empty: No daily spend records found in the {{days}}-day window.

incompleteSplit.title: Incomplete Split
incompleteSplit.body: {{amount}} of the spend in this window carries no cost source, so it is in Total Spend but in neither the API nor the Subsidized column. The two columns therefore under-report and must not be read as a complete split.

avgCostPlan.subtitle: Recent plans; a dash means the rows were never priced

note.title: 7-Day Rolling Average
note.body_one: Average Cost per Plan calculates the mean execution and agent spend for plans created in the last {{count}} day that reached {{states}} state. Unpriced plans (e.g. subscription runs where cost is null) are excluded from the divisor so they do not artificially deflate the average.
note.body_other: Average Cost per Plan calculates the mean execution and agent spend for plans created in the last {{count}} days that reached {{states}} state. Unpriced plans (e.g. subscription runs where cost is null) are excluded from the divisor so they do not artificially deflate the average.

plans.empty: No plans created in the {{days}}-day rolling window.
